in_marathi.name: Gomateshwar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gomateshwar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gomateshwar is a name derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Goma’ meaning ‘earth’ and ‘Ishwar’ meaning ‘lord’. This name is associated with Lord Shiva, who is often depicted as ‘Gomateshwar’ or ‘Lord of the Earth’. The name signifies the deep connection between the divine and the earth, and the reverence for the earth as a source of life and nourishment.
